definitions.gloss: every other month; every two months; bimonthly
definitions.explanation: Occurring once every two months, with one month skipped in between. The kanji {隔|かく} means 'to separate' or 'at intervals.'

examples.japanese: この{雑誌|ざっし}は{隔月|かくげつ}{発行|はっこう}だ。
{隔月|かくげつ}で{会議|かいぎ}を{開|ひら}いている。
examples.english: We hold meetings every other month.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}は{隔月|かくげつ}で{受|う}けることにしている。
examples.english: I make a point of getting health checkups every other month.

notes:
The prefix {隔|かく} means 'at intervals of' and is used in several time-related compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隔月|かくげつ}{発行|はっこう} — bimonthly publication
- {隔月|かくげつ}で — every other month
- {隔月|かくげつ}{刊|かん} — bimonthly journal

RELATED TERMS:
- {隔週|かくしゅう} — every other week
- {隔年|かくねん} — every other year
- {隔日|かくじつ} — every other day
- {毎月|まいつき} — every month (without skipping)

USAGE:
Used mainly in formal or organizational contexts — schedules, publications, and regular events. In casual conversation, {二|に}ヶ{月|げつ}に{一回|いっかい} (once every two months) is more natural.
